_comment: KANTO ITEMS DATABASE: Comprehensive catalog of all items available in the Kanto region, with anime-style descriptions and cultural significance.

items.name: Potion
items.description: A healing spray that Pokémon seem to enjoy. Makes them feel refreshed and cared for.
items.anime_description: A gentle pink spray that heals wounds and shows your Pokémon you care about their wellbeing.
items.cultural_significance: Symbol of trainer care and responsibility
items.usage_tips: Best used immediately after battle to show concern for your Pokémon
anime_moments: Ash healing Pikachu after Team Rocket battles

items.name: Super Potion
items.description: A more powerful healing spray for serious injuries. Shows deep commitment to your Pokémon's health.
items.anime_description: A concentrated healing formula that can help Pokémon recover from severe battles.
items.cultural_significance: Used by dedicated trainers who invest in their Pokémon's wellbeing
items.usage_tips: Save for after tough gym battles or when your Pokémon is badly hurt

items.name: Hyper Potion
items.description: Advanced healing technology that can restore a Pokémon from near-fainting.
items.anime_description: A premium healing solution that shows professional-level care for your Pokémon.
items.cultural_significance: Mark of a serious trainer who prepares for tough challenges
items.usage_tips: Essential for Elite Four battles and legendary encounters

items.name: Max Potion
items.description: The ultimate healing item that can fully restore any Pokémon's health.
items.anime_description: A miraculous healing solution that can bring a Pokémon back from the brink of defeat.
items.cultural_significance: Reserved for the most important battles and desperate situations
items.usage_tips: Save for Champion battles and critical story moments

items.name: Poké Ball
items.description: The standard Pokémon capture device. Represents the beginning of every trainer's journey.
items.anime_description: A red and white sphere that symbolizes the bond between trainer and Pokémon.
items.cultural_significance: Symbol of the trainer profession and Pokémon partnership
items.usage_tips: Best on weakened Pokémon, throw with confidence and care
items.capture_philosophy: Success depends on the Pokémon's willingness to join you

items.name: Great Ball
items.description: An improved Poké Ball with better capture technology and success rate.
items.anime_description: A blue and red ball that shows a trainer's growing expertise and dedication.
items.cultural_significance: Sign of a developing trainer who invests in better equipment
items.usage_tips: Use for rare Pokémon or when regular Poké Balls aren't enough
items.capture_philosophy: Better technology helps, but the bond still matters most

items.name: Ultra Ball
items.description: A high-performance Poké Ball designed for challenging captures.
items.anime_description: A yellow and black ball that represents serious trainer dedication and skill.
items.cultural_significance: Used by professional trainers and gym leaders
items.usage_tips: Essential for legendary encounters and powerful wild Pokémon
items.capture_philosophy: Advanced technology for the most challenging captures

items.name: Master Ball
items.description: The ultimate Poké Ball that never fails to capture any Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A legendary purple ball that represents the pinnacle of capture technology.
items.cultural_significance: Symbol of the ultimate trainer achievement
items.usage_tips: Save for the most important Pokémon of your journey
items.capture_philosophy: When used, it should be for a Pokémon that will change your life

items.name: Thunder Stone
items.description: A stone crackling with electrical energy that can evolve certain Electric-type Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A yellow stone that pulses with lightning energy, awakening dormant power in Electric Pokémon.
items.cultural_significance: Sacred to Electric-type Pokémon and their trainers
items.usage_tips: Use when your Pokémon is ready for the responsibility of evolution
items.evolution_philosophy: Evolution should be a choice made together with your Pokémon

items.name: Water Stone
items.description: A blue stone that shimmers like ocean waves, triggering evolution in Water-type Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A crystal-clear blue stone that holds the essence of pure water and the sea.
items.cultural_significance: Blessed by water spirits and ocean guardians
items.usage_tips: Best used near water, when your Pokémon feels the call of the sea
items.evolution_philosophy: Like water, evolution flows naturally when the time is right

items.name: Fire Stone
items.description: A red stone that burns with inner flame, awakening the fire within certain Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A crimson stone that radiates warmth and contains the spirit of eternal flame.
items.cultural_significance: Sacred to Fire-type Pokémon and volcano spirits
items.usage_tips: Use when your Pokémon's inner fire burns brightest
items.evolution_philosophy: Evolution ignites when passion and readiness meet

items.name: Bicycle
items.description: A fast and reliable way to travel across the Kanto region with your Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A trusty bike that represents freedom and adventure in the Pokémon world.
items.cultural_significance: Symbol of trainer independence and adventure spirit
items.usage_tips: Perfect for exploring routes and racing with friends
items.adventure_philosophy: The journey is just as important as the destination

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.description: A tool for catching Water-type Pokémon and connecting with aquatic life.
items.anime_description: More than just a tool - a bridge between land and sea, trainer and Water Pokémon.
items.cultural_significance: Traditional tool connecting trainers to Water-type Pokémon
items.usage_tips: Patience and persistence are key to successful fishing
items.philosophy: Fishing teaches patience and respect for Water Pokémon

items.name: Silph Scope
items.description: A special device that reveals the true nature of Ghost-type Pokémon.
items.anime_description: A mystical lens that allows trainers to see and interact with Ghost Pokémon.
items.cultural_significance: Sacred tool for communicating with the spirit world
items.usage_tips: Essential for Pokémon Tower and Ghost-type encounters
items.philosophy: Understanding Ghost Pokémon requires seeing beyond the physical world

items.name: X Attack
items.description: A supplement that boosts a Pokémon's Attack power during battle.
items.anime_description: A energy-boosting supplement that helps Pokémon reach their full potential.
items.cultural_significance: Used by competitive trainers and in important battles
items.usage_tips: Best used on physical attackers before big moves
items.battle_philosophy: Supplements enhance natural ability, they don't replace training

items.name: X Defend
items.description: A supplement that strengthens a Pokémon's defensive capabilities.
items.anime_description: A protective supplement that helps Pokémon withstand powerful attacks.
items.cultural_significance: Favored by defensive trainers and gym leaders
items.usage_tips: Use when facing powerful physical attackers
items.battle_philosophy: Sometimes the best offense is a strong defense

items.name: Oran Berry
items.description: A sweet berry that Pokémon love to eat. Restores health naturally.
items.anime_description: A blue berry that Pokémon find irresistible and deeply nourishing.
items.cultural_significance: Traditional Pokémon food and healing remedy
items.usage_tips: Give to Pokémon as treats or let them find wild ones
items.philosophy: Natural healing creates stronger bonds than artificial items

items.name: Pecha Berry
items.description: A pink berry that cures poison and tastes deliciously sweet.
items.anime_description: A pink berry with healing properties that Pokémon find comforting.
items.cultural_significance: Traditional remedy for poison-type attacks
items.usage_tips: Keep handy when exploring areas with Poison-type Pokémon
items.philosophy: Nature provides the best remedies for natural ailments

items.name: Pokédex
items.description: A high-tech encyclopedia that records information about Pokémon you encounter.
items.anime_description: A trainer's most important tool, representing the quest for knowledge and understanding.
items.effect: Records Pokémon data and provides information
items.cultural_significance: Symbol of the trainer's dedication to learning about Pokémon
items.usage_tips: Check it regularly to learn about new Pokémon you encounter
items.philosophy: Knowledge and understanding are the foundation of being a great trainer

items.name: Town Map
items.description: A detailed map of the Kanto region showing all cities, routes, and landmarks.
items.anime_description: A guide to adventure that shows the vast world waiting to be explored.
items.effect: Shows current location and available destinations
items.cultural_significance: Essential tool for any trainer's journey
items.usage_tips: Plan your route and discover new places to explore
items.philosophy: A good trainer always knows where they are and where they're going
